title: CERT-In unauthorised transactions advisory: scope corrected from the advisory itself; record merged as a duplicate
what_changed: The follow-up desk read CERT-In advisory CIAD-2026-0062 (20 November 2026). It says the unauthorised transactions involve organisations outside the financial sector (service providers supporting government-linked payment workflows, vendor or partner payout platforms), not financial service providers as the earlier title said from the Reuters relay. The advisory was already on file as cert-in-ai-driven-payment-workflow-attacks-warning-2026-11, first seen earlier, so this record is now marked duplicate_of that event.
